purpose: Prevent any visual, functional, data, permission, release or deferred finding from being lost between iterations.

findings.finding: The first scoped channel-cleanup patch made the workflow YAML invalid because an embedded heredoc body escaped the run-block indentation.
findings.rootCause: The initial quota-cleanup patch accidentally duplicated the remainder of the B2 workflow, including Exact B2 Preview readback and the authenticated-preview job; later edits only repaired the first visible malformed segment and left duplicate YAML keys.
findings.remediation: Restore workflow bytes from last known-good executable commit 7f55a407..., then apply only one minimal call to the versioned Preview GC tool; assert critical job/step cardinality=1 before commit.
findings.closureProof: GitHub accepts workflow syntax, central guard passes and B2 deploy job starts.

findings.finding: Firebase Hosting Preview channel quota reached after repeated recovery previews.
findings.rootCause: Preview channels were created repeatedly during recovery but the active B2 executor had no safe garbage collection for obsolete unreferenced B2 channels.
findings.remediation: On quota-only failure, invoke versioned safe GC tool: delete only unreferenced recovery gi-* Preview channels, preserve every versioned reference/live, then retry exact deploy once.
findings.closureProof: B2 Hosting Preview deploy succeeds after scoped cleanup; exact readback follows; live/data remain untouched.

findings.finding: B2 Hosting Preview deploy failed but the workflow hid Firebase's diagnostic because set -e exited before the redirected deploy output was printed.
findings.rootCause: Executor observability defect: failing command redirected stdout/stderr to b2-preview.json and shell exited before cat.
findings.remediation: Capture deploy return code under set +e, print the complete Firebase response, then fail closed with the same return code.
findings.closureProof: Next B2 Preview run either deploys successfully or surfaces the exact Firebase failure; no hidden deploy error.

findings.finding: Single-candidate rule existed semantically but not as one machine-authoritative physical composition; guard/workflow/locks duplicated composition/state knowledge.
findings.rootCause: The project required one accumulative candidate, but physical product composition authorization was distributed across Control Plane, B1/B2 locks, historical successor scopes and hardcoded status lists in the guard/workflow. A legitimate new remediation state could therefore make the guard ignore already-authorized product owners and report false source drift. This also made preservation of prior improvements dependent on multiple consumers staying manually synchronized.
findings.remediation: Create exact-set/blob-bound canonical composition lock and make central guard consume it independent of block status strings.
findings.closureProof: Central guard PASS and B2 Preview executor reaches build/proof on the same HEAD without product-source drift.

findings.finding: Access/synchronization email reported sent but Fernando did not receive it in any mailbox.
findings.rootCause: Not yet proven end-to-end; provider/request acceptance is not delivery proof.
findings.remediation: Preserve as explicit debt; verify transactional sender/domain/provider/delivery telemetry and real receipt without weakening public emailVerified requirement.

findings.finding: Inicio/Dashboard must reconcile KPI/advisor/monthly reality with active-role scoped canonical data.
findings.rootCause: Mixed-scope aggregation was previously demonstrated; active-role scope fix passed but final dashboard reality closure remains open.
findings.remediation: Close before B4 promotion; no reimport.

findings.finding: BODY_TYPOGRAPHY_TOO_HEAVY
findings.rootCause: Inline field values used font-weight 650 almost universally and premium rows used generalized <b>, flattening hierarchy.
findings.remediation: Body values reduced to medium weight; premium rows use ordinary values with strong total only; title/KPI hierarchy preserved.

findings.finding: BASE_GRAVABLE_SEMANTICS_AND_SUMMARY_NOISE
findings.rootCause: Canonical model supports taxable base, but summary rendered the missing value as a completion warning and used ambiguous label.
findings.remediation: Model retained; UI renders 'Base imponible para IVA' only when authoritative value exists.
findings.closureProof: Policy with base and policy without base; no invented value and no empty summary noise.

findings.finding: FORMA_PAGO_CONDUCTO_CROSS_FALLBACK_DUPLICATION
findings.rootCause: Read normalizer cross-fell back formaPago<-conductoPago and conducto<-formaPago; I6.4 source contract imports them separately.
findings.remediation: Cross-fallback removed. formaPago reads formaPago/metodoPago; conducto reads conducto/conductoPago; frequency stays separate.
findings.closureProof: Runtime records with distinct values and legacy missing values; write/readback stays distinct.

findings.finding: EDIT_EXISTING_POLICY_DOES_NOT_PERSIST_IN_HUMAN_FLOW
findings.rootCause: Prior authenticated PASS never edited a policy field; it edited only vehicle color. Engine also required motivo only for a subset of critical fields, while UI declared motive mandatory. Exact human-field failure remains runtime-discriminant pending.
findings.remediation: Every existing-policy update now requires motive; UI validates clearly before submit; authenticated proof now edits sumaAsegurada, asserts empty-motive zero write, valid-motive backend readback and reload.
findings.closureProof: Synthetic existing policy same ID: empty motive block -> valid save -> Firestore readback -> reload.

findings.finding: POLICY_VEHICLE_RELATIONSHIP_AMBIGUOUS_FOR_OBSERVED_CLIENT
findings.owner: canonical Firestore read models + relationship audit tool
findings.rootCause: Not assumed. Human evidence can represent distinct historical/current contracts plus an incomplete active vehicle link; physical IDs must decide.
findings.remediation: No data mutation. Read-only forensic script added for exact client and reported policy numbers.
findings.closureProof: Artifact evidence with hashed IDs, states, links, receipt/portfolio counts and classification; no merge/delete.

findings.finding: NO_CLEAR_EDIT_VEHICLE_ACTION
findings.rootCause: Buttons labeled 'Editar vehículo' called editarPoliza(polizaId); no dedicated vehicle editor owner existed.
findings.remediation: Dedicated openVehicleForm(vehicleId) added; actions call editarVehiculo(vehicleId); engine performs same-ID vehicle update through policy atomic write plan.
findings.closureProof: Authenticated edit -> exact vehicle doc readback -> one vehicle for policy -> reload -> policy/client link preserved.

findings.finding: VISIBLE_UNDEFINED_TEXT
findings.rootCause: Legacy row/identity renderers allowed literal string 'undefined'/'null' to pass through.
findings.remediation: Vehicle labels and row values normalize null/undefined literals to neutral display values; identity concatenation filters invalid literals.
findings.closureProof: Authenticated vehicle cards/detail no literal undefined/null.

findings.finding: PARTIAL_FIRST_RENDER_THEN_FULL_12_RECEIPTS
findings.rootCause: Cliente360 rendered legacy receipts first; canonical bridge replaced it in setTimeout(0), creating a visible partial-state race.
findings.remediation: Canonical patch/render now executes synchronously after the original tab/render handler; canonical owner keeps stable loading state until both receipt and portfolio collections are server-confirmed.
findings.closureProof: Authenticated cold route/tab/reload; no partial row count before canonical dataset.

findings.finding: TECHNICAL_TERMS_AND_HARSH_VISUAL_HIERARCHY
findings.rootCause: UI printed raw provenance fields/codes and separate state/reconciliation badges even when semantically identical; hero used unrelated dark treatment.
findings.remediation: Soft mature-family hero; medium body typography; deduplicated badges; raw authority/match codes suppressed; operational labels for update date/document/match.
findings.closureProof: Authenticated receipt detail desktop/mobile; no release/gate/validator/internal codes or duplicate payment status.

findings.finding: LOGO_NOT_ADMINISTRABLE
findings.rootCause: Ficha rendered a.logo, but edit form/snapshot/diff did not expose or track logo.
findings.remediation: Logo added to editable/diff contract as HTTPS URL only; Data URL/browser persistence is rejected; readback/reload proof added.
findings.closureProof: Synthetic insurer logo URL save -> canonical backend readback -> reload -> image rendered.

findings.finding: SECURE_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD_UPDATE_FAILS
findings.rootCause: Backend MANAGE_ROLES omitted Operativo although approved policy grants it; Preview callable explicitly rejected credential import.
findings.remediation: Operativo restored to server manage roles. Preview writes use isolated Secret Manager vault overlay, production vault remains unchanged. Preview-only synthetic cleanup added. Workflow deploys only Preview callable.
findings.closureProof: Authenticated Operativo synthetic insurer password update -> credentialRef readback -> refresh/reveal hash match -> Preview secret cleanup; no plaintext/log/artifact.

findings.finding: VISIBLE_CATALOG_COUNT_DISCREPANCY_25_VS_RUNTIME_LARGER
findings.rootCause: Session owner returns canonical role SuperAdmin while visual label is Dirección; Academia privileged filter recognized Dirección/Admin only. SuperAdmin therefore received exactly the Operativo subset.
findings.remediation: Privileged filter now recognizes Dirección, SuperAdmin, AdminTenant and Admin consistently.
findings.closureProof: Authenticated privileged role and Operativo/Asesor counts/routes; CRM/Cliente360 and Aseguradoras courses present; no technical/LAB visible to normal roles.

findings.finding: MATURE_VISUAL_FAMILY_NOT_YET_CONSISTENT
findings.owner: detail guard + receipt projection + Cliente360 + Aseguradoras
findings.rootCause: Policy/receipt/vehicle surfaces used independent inline weights and receipt-specific dark hero instead of mature family hierarchy.
findings.remediation: Targeted typography/hero/value-weight changes applied without reverting macro policy hierarchy.
findings.closureProof: Own visual audit desktop/mobile across Cliente360, Aseguradoras, Policy, Vehicle, Receipt, Academia; new Paula review afterward.
